name: Motive
description: Motive is an AI-powered physical-operations platform for fleet management, driver safety, equipment monitoring, maintenance, spend, workforce management, and compliance. Its fleet product combines real-time GPS and telematics with diagnostics, routing context, driver workflows, fuel insights, and maintenance automation.
best_for: Commercial fleets that want telematics, ELD/compliance, driver safety, vehicle maintenance, equipment visibility, and workforce workflows on one operational platform.
features: Real-time GPS tracking with live traffic, weather overlays, historical activity, and driver/vehicle pairing
ELD, HOS, IFTA, CSA, and driver-qualification compliance workflows
Vehicle diagnostics, inspections, scheduled maintenance, work orders, parts, and maintenance cost controls
Fuel, idling, EV utilization, sustainability, and operational efficiency insights
Driver and Fleet mobile apps for ELD, assignments, checklists, alerts, and fleet visibility
AI dashcam and driver-safety capabilities integrated with telematics
Dispatch, equipment monitoring, reefer monitoring, and operational reporting across the Motive platform

tiers.name: Motive Fleet Management
tiers.notes: Motive directs buyers to Get started / Contact sales and account-specific billing; no public universal numeric fleet-management subscription price was found on current official product and billing pages.

pros: Combines telematics with compliance, maintenance, safety, equipment, and workforce capabilities
Real-time tracking data feeds directly into dispatch, maintenance, fuel, and compliance workflows
Supports fleets from small commercial operations through large enterprise deployments
cons: No public universal numeric fleet-management price
Hardware, cameras, equipment devices, and additional modules can make pricing deployment-specific
Some adjacent Motive products have separate subscription structures, so the platform should not be treated as one flat plan
